text:
kevin.b: ZenithPay POC checklist: IdP-initiated SAML, SCIM delta + group sync, Okta group->role mapping, tenant-level domain proofing (multiple subdomains), EU data residency, and delegated tenant admins. Need a quick presales runbook + ballpark Hosted vs Dedicated pricing. Who can take?

nina.r: I can draft pricing and security Qs. what's expected SCIM patch rate? if it's bursty we should recommend Dedicated.

chris.m: Sales note: ~30k users, ~8k DAU, daily full at 02:00 UTC, delta bursts during business hours (~4k ops/hour). High group churn (contractor onboarding). They want JIT + SCIM as fallback.

kevin.b: Can Redwood include Okta groups as a claim in the SAML assertion and support custom claim names? Also need guidance on nested groups.

chris.m: Yes — we support attribute mapping into assertions and custom claim names. For nested groups, we don't auto-flatten; recommend flattening at IdP or via a short sync lambda. I'll add a sample SAML attribute snippet to the runbook. Note: very large group counts can hit assertion size limits.

devops-bot: devops-bot: Draft hosted + quota quote uploaded: https://redwood.s3/prequotes/zenithpay-hosted-v1.pdf

nina.r: Preliminary ballparks (pre-sales): Hosted standard = ~$1.3k/mo; Hosted + SCIM quota bump = ~$3.2k/mo; Dedicated POC onboarding = $28k one-time; Dedicated reserved = ~$9k/mo. EU region premium applies.

kevin.b: Domain proofing: they asked about wildcard or delegated verification across brands (app.brand1.example, app.brand2.example).

chris.m: GA supports exact domain verification per tenant only. Wildcard/delegated proofing isn't GA. We can propose it as an engineering engagement tied to Dedicated/Private — estimate 3	6 weeks dev + testing as optional SOW.

kevin.b: Can someone paste a SCIM PATCH example for their SRE to test delta replays?

chris.m: Sample SCIM PATCH for email update:
```
curl -X PATCH "https://eu.api.redwood.com/scim/v2/Users/7f8e" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"emails[primary eq true].value","value":"sam.user@brand1.example"}]}'
```

nina.r: Plan: I'll send provisional pricing + security questionnaire answers, Chris will produce runbook snippets (SAML metadata exchange, SCIM delta replay, group-flatten guidance, delegated admin test plan), Kevin to schedule technical call for Wed 09:00 CET and add sec/ops.

kevin.b: Thanks team — let's keep momentum. :thumbsup:
